Message:
drm/i915/dp: Attach HDR metadata property to DP connector

It attaches HDR metadata property to DP connector on GLK+.
It enables HDR metadata infoframe sdp on GLK+ to be used to send
HDR metadata to DP sink.

v2: Minor style fix
